label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: No Memorial Changes
items.text: Muirfield Village saw no major course changes after last year's Memorial, surprising many fans ahead of the 2026 event.

items.headline: Charles Schwab Challenge Praise
items.text: The PGA Tour highly values the Charles Schwab Challenge at Colonial, calling it a "perfect golf course" setup ideal for the 2028 track one schedule with strong playing conditions and TV timing.

items.headline: DeChambeau’s AI Swing Fix
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau revealed he used AI advice to loosen his grip after a swing slump at LIV Golf Korea, but admitted the approach "did not fix" his game despite a final-round 65 and third place finish.
